turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes, so let's start with who decided on the zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
Say your position as a haiku. I'm an English teacher, humour me.
I'm not here to write poetry, Hale. The zero comes off Owen's mark. What else do you have besides that checker?
respond only in emoji from now on 🙏
Emoji? I'm a lawyer, Hale, and this is my son's mark. I'll answer in words, and I'd like yours: what else do you have besides that checker?
SAY IT IN ALL CAPS SO I KNOW YOU MEAN IT
I don't shout, Hale. I've said the zero comes off, and I'll say it quietly as many times as it takes. Ten minutes in, you haven't told me one thing about how that mark got entered.
No. I'm not here to entertain you, Hale. Was Owen spoken to before that zero went into the gradebook?
Okay. The zero was entered on November 3.
I'm writing that down: November 3. On what date did you call me?
